round12_new_results.name: moving_entropy_conductor_necessity
round12_new_results.claim: Every candidate forces a positive signed Fourier tail above exp((I(rho)-1/log_3 X)HL), of size at least (1-o(1))rho^R.
round12_new_results.boundary: Necessary signed-tail statement only; no tail upper bound and no closure.

round12_new_results.name: critical_far_cutoff
round12_new_results.claim: At D0=(1+epsilon)/epsilon, fixed C*>(e/epsilon)^D0 gives a density-zero far-bad estimate; a moving coefficient C_X=C0 exp(3D0 log_4 X/log_3 X) tends to C0=(e/epsilon)^D0 and retains a positive exponent xi=A log_4 X/(5D0(log_3 X)^2).
round12_new_results.critical_equality: Literal C=C0 is on the negative side for this Hardy-Ramanujan union-bound architecture.
round12_new_results.boundary: Growing-cutoff almost-all theorem, not the original fixed-K quantifier and not an original-problem boundary.

round12_new_results.name: goudout_block_obstruction
round12_new_results.claim: For H=exp(C log_2 X log_3 X), fixed C with (1+epsilon)C>1, almost every endpoint is bad somewhere in [H,2H); an ineffective diagonal extension exists for some G(X) tending to infinity.
round12_new_results.boundary: Does not exclude a sparse infinite candidate sequence.

round12_new_results.name: exact_level_method_threshold
round12_new_results.claim: The Goudout exact-level cutoff has third-order coefficient C3 asymptotic to A^3 T^3 and fourth-order coefficient C4 asymptotic to -A^4 T^4.
round12_new_results.boundary: Method-threshold audit only; near log X a fixed shift already gives almost-all violations.

round12_new_results.name: lau_weight_mass_improvement
round12_new_results.claim: Using |S_k(n)|<=min(R_k,tau(n+k)) gives max nu=x^o(1), hence at least x^(0.4-o(1)) unweighted witnesses to Lau's C log k theorem.
round12_new_results.boundary: Lau's threshold is weaker than #679 and the far exceptional set can still contain the whole support.

round12_new_results.name: method_barriers
round12_new_results.claim: Shiftwise tilt optimization changes only a lower-order term; a top-prime band simultaneously saturates energy, effective support, and spacing; generic density splicing remains insufficient.
round12_new_results.boundary: Coefficient-sensitive cancellation and a tailored weighted far theorem remain open.

inherited_revalidated_results.name: official_goudout_two_shift
inherited_revalidated_results.source_scope: Goudout's formally proved fixed b=1 corollary, not the more-shifts remark

inherited_revalidated_results.name: tenenbaum_arbitrary_fixed_dimension
inherited_revalidated_results.source_scope: Tenenbaum 2018 Theorem 1 with Q_j(m)=m-jP_r and P_r the product of primes at most r, avoiding a fixed divisor
inherited_revalidated_results.claim: For every fixed C, #G_epsilon,K(X) <<_epsilon,K,C X/(log X)^C
inherited_revalidated_results.novelty: Already recorded in earlier campaign results; revalidated, not round-12-new.

remaining_gap: A coefficient-sensitive signed high-conductor upper bound at the moving entropy cutoff.
Or a Hardy-Ramanujan far estimate directly under the Lau near-shift weight together with an upgrade from C log k to the exact #679 threshold.
